player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Admiral Twk''') posted a [[Dark]] [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further

description: A power house deck, efficient, brutal, and steady.
cards: This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
posted: Ghhk & Those rebels won't escape us
notes: Posted 27 May 2001, days before the Tatooine set's release; the list uses Tatooine cards (Aurra Sing, Darth Maul, Maul's Lightsaber, Fanfare; the author says they playtested with proxies from the spoiler) and no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting(8): This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further ('TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF'), Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber ('CCCarbonite Chamber'), Secret Plans, All Wrapped Up, Prepared Defenses, I'm Sorry, Combat Response and Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start and none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
Secret Plans and Fan Fare ('Fan Fare') dested the 2001 Effects (Special Edition Secret Plans, Tatooine Fanfare), not the later Reflections III Defensive Shields.
Posted 'Bespin' and 'Cloud City' dested the Dark Bespin (Dark) and Bespin: Cloud City (Dark); 'CCChasm Walkway' and 'CCWest Gallery' the Dark Cloud City sites.

Posted 'Boba Fett in S1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I (listed under Ships); 'Dengar w/ Gun' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine; '4-LOM w/ Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Vader w/ Saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Darth Maul' dested the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Mara Jade, TEH' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Aura Sing' dested Aurra Sing; 'Major Tur Phennir' dested Major Turr Phennir.

Posted 'Ghhk & Those rebels won't escape us', 'Evader & Monok', 'Sniper & Dark Strike' and 'Dr. Evazan & Ponda Boba' dested the Reflections II combo cards; 'Join Me' dested Join Me!; 'Maul's Saber' and 'Mara's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber and Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Editor's Note #2 floats possible changes (more Senses, OS-72-1 and OS-72-2 in ships, Tallon Roll & Dark Maneuvers, starting Fanfare); these are not in the list. The 'SC State' win mentioned in the matchups refers to a different (Light) deck.
